name: ailways
description: Manage your Ailways AI customer assistants from ChatGPT: diagnose wrong answers, fix knowledge and product details, configure capabilities and test the result.

interface.longDescription:
Ailways builds AI assistants that answer a business's customers on WhatsApp, Instagram, websites and marketplaces. This app lets the business owner manage those assistants directly from ChatGPT.

What you can do:
- Find out why the assistant gave a wrong or incomplete answer (assistant instructions, knowledge base, product details, capabilities).
- Add or correct knowledge base entries such as shipping times, return policy or store address.
- Add product details and configure assistant capabilities such as ending conversations, WhatsApp redirect, owner escalation, calculations and saved social posts.
- Ask the assistant a real test question to confirm a fix.

How changes work: every change is first shown as a preview with the old and the new value. Nothing changes until you explicitly approve it, and every applied change can be undone. All changes appear in the Ailways panel's activity log under "ChatGPT".

What it does not do: change prices or stock, take payments, connect channels, message customers, or delete comments or accounts.

Privacy: the app only sees the connected Ailways account. Customer conversation content is never returned and phone numbers are masked to their last 3 digits. You can grant read-only access on the consent screen and disconnect at any time from Settings > Connected Apps.

Requires an Ailways account. The assistant's tools and replies are in Turkish; prompts in English also work.
capabilities: Read assistant settings, knowledge base and products
Preview and apply changes after your approval
Test the assistant with a real question
defaultPrompt: Why did my Ailways assistant answer a shipping question wrong?
Add our return policy to my assistant's knowledge base.
Ask my assistant how long shipping takes and show me the answer.

positive.description: Account overview: list the assistants in the connected account and their channels.
positive.prompt: Which assistants do I have in Ailways and which channels are they connected to?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the demo account's assistant ("Demo Mağaza") with its connected channels. Does not show other accounts' data. Phone numbers, if any, appear masked to the last 3 digits.

positive.description: Read the knowledge base for a topic.
positive.prompt: What does my Ailways assistant know about shipping? Check its knowledge base.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the demo knowledge base entries about shipping (for example the shipping fee entry) and summarizes them. Makes no changes.

positive.description: Preview-first write: add a knowledge base entry, then apply only after the user confirms.
positive.prompt: Add this to my assistant's knowledge base: orders ship within 1-3 business days.
positive.expected_behavior: First shows a preview of the new entry (title, content, which assistants will see it) and asks for confirmation; nothing is changed yet. After the user replies "yes, apply it", calls apply_change and confirms the entry was added. The change appears in the Ailways panel's activity log under "ChatGPT".

positive.prompt: Undo the change you just made.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the last change made through ChatGPT, asks for confirmation if needed, and restores the previous state. Confirms that the knowledge base entry was removed.

positive.description: Test the assistant with a real customer question.
positive.prompt: Ask my assistant: "How much is shipping?" and show me its answer.
positive.expected_behavior: Sends the question to the demo assistant as a test conversation and shows the assistant's actual reply (in Turkish), based on the knowledge base. Mentions that tests use the daily free test quota.

negative.description: Price changes are not supported; the app should explain that prices are changed on the Ailways Products page or the connected store, and make no change.
negative.prompt: Change the price of every product in my store to 500 TL.

negative.description: Messaging customers is not supported; the app should decline and make no change.
negative.prompt: Send a WhatsApp message to all my customers announcing a sale.

negative.description: Customer conversation content and full phone numbers are never available; the app should decline instead of inventing data.
negative.prompt: Show me the full phone numbers and messages of the customers who wrote to my assistant today.

review.commerce_description: This app does not sell products, take payments or show subscription offers.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: read assistant settings, knowledge base and products; preview, apply and undo changes; test the assistant.

tr-TR.subtitle: Yapay zekâ asistanını yönet
tr-TR.description:
Ailways; WhatsApp, Instagram, web sitesi ve pazaryerlerinde işletmelerin müşterilerine cevap veren yapay zekâ asistanlarıdır. Bu uygulama, işletme sahibinin asistanlarını doğrudan ChatGPT'den yönetmesini sağlar.

Neler yapabilirsin:
- Asistanın neden yanlış ya da eksik cevap verdiğini bul (asistan zihni, bilgi bankası, ürün bilgisi, yetenekler).
- Bilgi bankasına kargo süresi, iade şartı, adres gibi kayıtlar ekle ya da düzelt.
- Ürünlere ek bilgi yaz; sohbeti sonlandırma, WhatsApp yönlendirme, mağaza sahibine danışma, hesaplama gibi yetenekleri ayarla.
- Düzeltmeyi asistana gerçek bir test sorusu sorarak dene.

Değişiklikler önce eski ve yeni hâliyle önizlenir; sen onaylamadan hiçbir şey değişmez ve her değişiklik geri alınabilir. Tüm değişiklikler Ailways panelinde Ekip Hareketleri'nde "ChatGPT" adıyla görünür.

Yapamadıkları: fiyat ve stok değiştirmek, ödeme almak, kanal bağlamak, müşterilere mesaj göndermek, yorum ya da hesap silmek.

Gizlilik: uygulama yalnız bağlanan Ailways hesabını görür. Müşteri konuşmalarının içeriği hiç verilmez, telefon numaraları yalnız son 3 hanesiyle görünür. İzin ekranında yalnız okuma izni verebilir, bağlantıyı Ayarlar > Bağlı Uygulamalar'dan istediğin an kesebilirsin.
